about_the_game:
"Akuro & Bahaku 2" is approximately 40 minutes in length, a visually engaging interactive novel filled with delightful interactions. Players advance the storyline through basic mouse operations like clicking/dragging, simulating character actions within the game world.

If you resonate with the following features, "Akuro & Bahaku 2" will surely captivate you:

  • Adorable shota and furry characters, along with their pure yet passionate friendship

  • Diverse and amusing interactive sequences, such as simulating puppy petting, washing off dust...

  • An emotionally rich narrative with dual endings, one deliberately concealed requiring player exploration

  • Gallery functionality unlocking behind-the-scenes manuscripts and production details inaccessible during gameplay after completing an ending

Plot Synopsis:
Street urchin Akuro, persecuted for his unusual appearance, finds salvation when explorer Bahaku emerges like sunlight to rescue him from darkness. During their heartwarming cohabitation, Akuro experiences happiness for the first time. But when confronted with catastrophic crisis, what choices will they make? Ultimately...who will survive?

short_description: A visual novel with fun interactions, rich story, vivid characters, cute art. Lonely Akuro meets life-changing friend Bahaku. Use clicks & drags to witness their passionate friendship! Immerse in joy, happiness, sorrow, feel friendship's power.
